sub_questions.question: Can I use my own model (or own provider/API key) with Dify?
Am I restricted to only what's offered in the Marketplace?

claims.claim: No, the customer cannot use their own model with Dify.
claims.guide_evidence: a workspace connects its **own** model provider

claims.claim: The customer is limited to the providers already listed in the Marketplace.
claims.guide_evidence: this guide does not enumerate which self-hosted runtimes currently have an official plugin.

claims.claim: OpenAI, Anthropic, and Azure OpenAI are officially published provider plugins.
claims.guide_evidence: OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure OpenAI, and others are published officially

claims.claim: Available providers are restricted to the officially published plugins.
claims.guide_evidence: additional community providers are also listed

claims.claim: There is no way to bring a model that isn't one of the listed providers.
claims.guide_evidence: It does not document ... the plugin SDK for building custom integrations

evaluation.rationale: The answer flatly says "No," but the guide says a workspace can connect its own model provider using its own API key, and it lists community providers as well as official ones. The claim that a model outside the listed providers can't be used at all goes beyond the guide. Custom integrations (the plugin SDK) and self-hosted runtimes are topics the guide says to route to specialists, so the answer should have done that instead of ruling them out. It also never clarifies whether Chidi means bringing his own API key or a custom or self-hosted model.
